Metadata.title: Extrack — Personal finance tracker
Metadata.description: Track wallets, expenses, savings and debt in one clear dashboard.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.

Common.tagline: Your finances, in one clear view.

Dashboard.noBudgetsTitle: No budgets set for this month
Dashboard.noBudgetsDesc: Create a budget per category to compare planned spending against what actually goes out.
Dashboard.noWalletsDesc: Create a wallet to start tracking your money.
Dashboard.addExpenseToSee: Add an expense to see your category breakdown.

Wallets.pageDesc: Cash, bank, savings, lend and debt accounts in one place.
Wallets.noWalletsDesc: Create your first wallet to start tracking money.
Wallets.recordedAsIncome: Recorded as income, so it shows up in your monthly totals.
Wallets.dontMoveMoney: Don't move money — just set the balance
Wallets.fundingMovesBalance: Picking a wallet moves the starting balance out of it and logs the move in both wallets' history.
Wallets.noSourceWallets: Add a cash, bank, or savings wallet to pay this debt from.
Wallets.onlyLentAmount: Only {amount} is still owed to you.
Wallets.noDestinationWallets: Add a cash, bank, or savings wallet to deposit this repayment into.
Wallets.deleteEmptyWalletDesc: This removes {name} from your wallet lists and pickers. Its transaction history stays in place — every past transaction still shows up on the Transactions page and in your totals.
Wallets.deleteNonEmptyWalletDesc: {name} still holds {amount}. {action} first — only an empty wallet can be deleted.

Transactions.pageDesc: Every expense, income and transfer across your wallets.
Transactions.deleteTransactionDesc: This removes the transaction and reverses its effect on the wallet balance. This can't be undone.
Transactions.noMatchDesc: Try widening your filters, or add a new transaction to get started.
Transactions.nothingToCompareDesc: Neither {base} nor {compare} has any expenses yet.
Transactions.noDebtWalletYet: You don't have a debt wallet yet. A debt payment clears an existing balance, so add a debt wallet from the {link} first — set its starting balance to what you already owe — then come back to record this payment.

Budgets.pageDescDefault: Set what you plan to spend per category, and see how {base} is tracking.
Budgets.deleteBudgetDesc: This removes the {category} budget for {month}/{year}. This can't be undone.
Budgets.categoriesOverBudget: {count, plural, one {# category over budget} other {# categories over budget}}
Budgets.categoriesCounted: {selectedDisplay} of {total, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} counted
Budgets.categoriesLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} left out of these totals
Budgets.noBudgetsDesc: Set a monthly budget per category to compare it against what you actually spend.
Budgets.noBudgetsProgressDesc: Create a budget to see your spending progress here.
Budgets.nothingToCompareDesc: Neither {base} nor {compare} has a budget yet.
Budgets.noCategoriesLeft: Every category already has a budget for that month — pick a different month, or edit the existing one.
Budgets.countEveryCategory: Count every category toward the totals
Budgets.copyBudgetDesc: Copy every budgeted category from another month into {month}. Categories that already have a budget this month are left as they are.
Budgets.willCopyHeading: {count, plural, one {Will copy # category} other {Will copy # categories}}
Budgets.alreadyBudgetedHeading: {count, plural, one {Already budgeted here — # category left as is} other {Already budgeted here — # categories left as is}}
Budgets.copyBudgetNothingToCopy: Every category in {source} already has a budget in {target}. Pick a different month to copy from.
Budgets.copyBudgetSuccess: {copied, plural, one {Copied # budget} other {Copied # budgets}} into {month}.
Budgets.copyBudgetSuccessWithSkipped: {copied, plural, one {Copied # budget} other {Copied # budgets}} into {month}. {skipped, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} already had a budget there and {skipped, plural, one {was} other {were}} left as is.

Debts.pageDesc: Credit cards and loans — what you owe, at a glance.
Debts.noDebtWalletsDesc: Add a debt wallet for a credit card or loan to track what you owe and pay it down over time.
Debts.tip: Tip: an {expense} on a debt wallet increases what you owe (e.g. a credit card purchase); use {clearDebt} on a wallet's page to pay it down. Once it's fully paid off, the wallet drops off the Wallets page — its history stays visible here.

Savings.pageDesc: Money set aside, growing quietly in the background.
Savings.noSavingsWalletsDesc: Create a savings wallet, then transfer money into it to start building a cushion.
Savings.tip: Tip: record a {transfer} from a cash or bank wallet into a savings wallet to move money into savings — its balance updates automatically.

Lend.pageDesc: Money you've lent to others — what's still owed back to you.
Lend.noLendWalletsDesc: Add a lend wallet when you lend money to someone, then track it here until they pay you back.
Lend.tip: Tip: pick Lend as the category on an {expense} (or transfer money in directly) when you hand money to someone; use {getRepaid} on the wallet's page when they pay it back. Once it's fully repaid, the wallet drops off the Wallets page — its history stays visible here.
